# ESP32-S3 ChaCha20-Poly1305 stack A/B (#275, #278, #279, #280), CPU at 80 MHz: every image

rind's time for each image, in µs: the median over that image's flashes, with the number of flashes (n) and the spread (slowest − fastest flash) / fastest. A ratio is the image's median over the control's (`ctl`); below 1 is faster than the control. `ctl` was flashed 5 times; `zero` was flashed once; `chacha` was flashed once; `all` was flashed once. An image flashed once has one run, so its spread is 0 and says nothing about repeatability; read it against the control's spread. The RustCrypto column is the median of every flash of every image (the same RustCrypto code in each image, a layout control). Every number here is recomputed from [ab.json](ab.json) by `cargo verify`.
